meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划交给它,自动拆成并行任务并逐步跑完
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有详细计划但不想手动一项项执行。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan to completion with parallel tasks and tracked progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want it executed without doing each step by hand.

howto.what: Claude 变为只做编排、不亲自写代码:读取 .omo/plans 下的 ulw-plan 计划,把每个勾选项拆成子任务派给并行子代理,记录 Boulder 状态与证据台账,每个波次在独立 worktree 中执行并交付。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 里的计划时触发;若没有可选计划,你说「start work」这类指令会先走 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 执行 .omo/plans 里匹配的计划
每个阶段的成果以 PR 形式交付
PR 开出后跟到合并,再清理 worktree

howto.what_en: Claude acts only as an orchestrator: it reads a ulw-plan under .omo/plans, splits each checkbox into sub-tasks for parallel subagents, keeps Boulder state and an evidence ledger, and runs each wave in its own worktree.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; with no selectable plan, saying start work makes it bootstrap ulw-plan first.

say_en.note: Delivers each phase as a pull request
Stays until the PR is merged, then cleans up
